description: A person in the ministry's community. They sign up, an admin lets them in, and then they post, heart, comment and pray. The builder is the first admin and can make volunteers admins later.

columns.name: login
columns.description: a member is who signs in

columns.name: endedAt
columns.description: an admin can block a member: they can no longer sign in, and an admin can let them back

description: What a member shares in the feed: one or more photos and a caption. A prayer request, a testimony and an event are posts of their own kind. Not kept by the database yet: a post's eventOn matters only when its kind is "event", and is there then; a post's hiddenReason matters only once it has ended.

columns.name: member
columns.description: each post is by one member

columns.name: endedAt
columns.description: an admin can hide a post; members no longer see it, admins still do

description: A few words a member writes under a post. Not kept by the database yet: a comment's hiddenReason matters only once it has ended.

columns.name: post
columns.description: each comment is under one post

columns.name: member
columns.description: each comment is by one member

columns.name: endedAt
columns.description: an admin can hide a comment; members no longer see it, admins still do

description: The ministry's reading for one day: a title, the scripture it is on and the text. The archive comes from the old blog's files; new ones are written in the app. Each morning the day's one is pinned at the top of the feed, and anyone can open it from a link, without an account. Not kept by the database yet: a devotional's archiveFile matters only when its source is "archive", and is there then.

columns.name: member
columns.description: a devotional written in the app is by the admin who wrote it
